title: Restrict isolated SEO Preview to read-only rendering
summary: Add request and fetch allowlists, restrictive browser policy and disabled session restoration in the isolated candidate. No deployment or hosted credential execution.

changes.detail: Allow only enumerated SEO GET/HEAD routes and staging REST reads; reject writes, auth, API calls and redirect-based outbound bypasses.
Disable Preview browser Supabase transport, session restoration, tracking, chat, push and polling; retain existing email guards.

validation.name: Local security and regression validation
validation.detail: Pending tests and fixture build. Hosted verifier and real staging acceptance are not authorized or executed.
